summary: Ansible 9.0.0 removed the collections cisco.nso, community.fortios, community.google, community.skydive, ngine_io.vultr and servicenow.servicenow.
questions: Which collections were dropped from Ansible 9?
Is community.google still in the Ansible package?
What version of ngine_io.vultr was last bundled?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 9
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from the Ansible 9 package (last bundled version):

- cisco.nso 1.0.3
- community.fortios 1.0.0
- community.google 1.0.0
- community.skydive 1.0.0
- ngine_io.vultr 1.1.3
- servicenow.servicenow 1.0.6

Install separately with `ansible-galaxy collection install <name>` if needed.
